Maria (ACME): Hey team, we started getting 429s from the Redwood API around 09:21 UTC after flipping our edge proxy. It looks like a sudden spike — ~2k req/min for a few minutes. Any quick idea?
Emma (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, Maria. Can you paste a sample request id or one of the response headers? We should check X-RateLimit headers if present.
Maria (ACME): Response has: `x-ratelimit-limit: 1200`, `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`, and body: `{"error":"Too Many Requests"}`. Our client was retrying aggressively, not much jitter.
Jasper (SRE): Thanks — that header suggests you're hitting a per-minute token bucket (RPM). Is your traffic coming through a new gateway/sidecar that retries on 5xx? That can amplify bursts.
Emma (Support): Also confirm whether you're using a shared key (hosted plan) or dedicated capacity. Shared keys have stricter per-key quotas and burst caps.
Maria (ACME): Shared key for now. We rolled out a proxy that retries 3x with no backoff. I think it queued some slow requests and then replayed them.
Alex (Infra): That replay pattern + retries explains the 2k/m burst. The platform will surface 429s when the token bucket drains. We can do a temporary quota bump while you patch client retries.
ratebot: Deploy detected: edge-proxy v2.3 deployed 09:19 UTC (staging->prod).
Jasper (SRE): Action items: (1) stop automatic retrying ASAP or add exponential backoff with jitter, (2) we can enable a short quota increase for your API key for 30m to smooth customer impact, (3) I want request samples to confirm whether requests are identical (replays).
Emma (Support): Maria, can you change your proxy retry policy to `max_retries=1` and add `jitter=full`? If you need a YAML snippet, here's an example:```yaml
retry:
  max_attempts: 1
  backoff:
    type: exponential
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 2000
  jitter: full
```
Maria (ACME): Doing that now. Also how do we detect in logs if our client is the repeater vs. upstream?
Jasper (SRE): Look at consecutive requests from same client IP + identical payloads within <500ms window. If you see clustered timestamps and identical bodies, that's replay. On our side we saw many identical request digests during the spike.
Emma (Support): For immediate mitigation we've applied a temporary per-minute increase of +800 RPM to your key for 45 minutes (expires automatically). That should reduce 429s while you roll out the retry fix.
Maria (ACME): Thanks — after changing retry policy, the 429s dropped within ~2 minutes. We're running load tests now to validate.
Alex (Infra): Long term options: (1) move to Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, (2) implement client-side rate buckets respecting `x-ratelimit-*`, (3) use batching where possible to reduce per-request token usage.
Maria (ACME): Can you share a repro script so we can simulate the exact burst pattern? Would like to run it locally.
Jasper (SRE): Sure — here's a simple k6-style pseudocode you can use to reproduce the retry amplification behavior:```js
// pseudo k6 script
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  // many virtual users firing the same request
  const res = http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'x'}), {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer KEY'}});
  if (res.status >= 500 && res.status < 600) {
    // naive retry loop used in your proxy
    for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
      http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'x'}), {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer KEY'}});
    }
  }
  sleep(1);
}
```
Emma (Support): If you want to emulate the exact timing we saw, run 200 VUs ramping up over 30s and remove jitter from retries. That will recreate the amplification.
Maria (ACME): Running it now — confirmed. With naive retries we hit 429s quickly; with exponential backoff+full jitter it's stable.
Jasper (SRE): Good. We'll keep the temporary quota bump in place until your change is fully deployed + validated. After that we'll let it expire.
Alex (Infra): One more tip: honor the `Retry-After` header on 429s. If your proxy already understands that, ensure it doesn't translate it to immediate retries.
Maria (ACME): Noted. Anything else we should watch for?
Emma (Support): We'll enable alerting on sustained `x-ratelimit-remaining == 0` spikes for your key and open a short post-mortem to capture the root cause and mitigation steps. We'll DM you when the PM is ready. :white_check_mark:
Maria (ACME): Appreciate the quick help, team.
Jasper (SRE): No problem — ping here if anything resurfaces.
ratebot: Quota increase applied to key KEY-xxx by Emma (Support) — +800 RPM until 09:57 UTC.
